card.name: Scattered mid-sentence words, no theme
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on mixed spots such as a word ending (eromen-os), the word 'in' after 'treatment', and 'compared' after a percentage.

modes.label: 'in' after a treatment noun
modes.description: The word 'in' right after a noun phrase, before a patient or setting.
modes.example: sufficient time must elapse before initiating TCA treatment<< in>> a patient being withdrawn from fluoxetine,

modes.label: 'compared' after a change
modes.description: The word 'compared' following a stated percentage increase.
modes.example: mean gabapentin AUC increased by 44%<< compared>> to gabapentin administered without morphine
